name: Value DeFi vStake ProfitSharingRewardPool initializer never sets its initialized flag
summary: ProfitSharingRewardPool.initialize() is guarded by notInitialized but never sets initialized, so anyone could re-initialize the vStake proxy and become operator. The attacker did so with a dummy stake token, pulled the staked vBSWAP/BUSD LP via governanceRecoverUnsupported, re-initialized with the real LP and pulled the WBNB and BUSD rewards.
notes: The proxy constructor set implementation 0x7a8ac384 with no Upgraded event; the only later upgrade is the post-exploit fix, so the proxy's creation is the reset. The anchor is the attacker's first initialize, per the unprotected-initializer rule.

The stolen vBSWAP/BUSD LP is reported as the underlying its burn released. vBSWAP has no DefiLlama price, so it is valued at the attacker's realised proceeds: the WBNB its 1inch sale returned, at the WBNB price. BUSD is at par.
The 2021-05-07 vSafe WBNB incident (eip155:56:0xa00def91954ba9f1a1320ef582420d41ca886d417d996362bf3ac3fe2bfb9006) is a different defect, contract and attacker and stays a separate record.
